targets.review_note: Visit the deepest room immediately, then collect items while returning outward: moving costs zero, and reordering a deeper-room pickup before a shallower-room pickup never hurts any exit deadline. Prefix minima of door deadlines give each depth its strict integer-time capacity (deadline minus1). Process rooms deepest first using unbounded knapsack. When moving outward, extend at-most-time DP with its previous final value, retaining the requirement that deep-room work was completed before its tighter deadline. All gem types retain their own time/value; no greedy value-per-time approximation.
